name: Zul'Gurub: Thekal's Rip ends when the bleeding player dies
contract: High Priest Thekal's Rip (2118240 and its difficulty versions 2118241-2118243, SpellDifficulty 2351) carries
SPELL_ATTR3_ALLOW_AURA_WHILE_DEAD in the client DBC, so it stayed on a dead player and killed them again after
a battle resurrection (round-7 tester, 2026-11-14). A player's Rip now ends with that player's death, like
Arlokk's Razor Claws: the Normal and the Mythic version both leave with the hero's death.

steps.label: The hero carries the Normal Rip
The hero carries the Mythic Rip

DISCRIMINATING: the Normal Rip ends with the hero's death
DISCRIMINATING: the Mythic Rip ends with the hero's death
